arguments.value: NVOS and HGF formed a joint venture to develop, manage, and operate hemp and medicinal cannabis farming projects in Canada, with NVOS handling development, operations, sales, financing, records, and product purchasing, and HGF providing land, farming expertise, approvals, labor, and crop production. The venture is to be run through a Canadian company called Novo Earth Therapeutics Inc., with offices at NVOS’s head office and project sites. HGF is expected to provide at least 7,000 acres and related land documentation, while NVOS is responsible for business planning, facilities, financing, and product contracts. Profits are generally split 70% to NVOS and 30% to HGF, and HGF is also to receive 30% of net company income annually starting after the first full revenue year; NVOS may also issue shares if certain profit targets are met. The agreement lasts five years, can be renewed, and includes rules for accounting, taxes, confidentiality, assignment, dispute resolution by mediation/arbitration, and mutual indemnification.
